responses.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804;

assumptions.assumption: Average bytes per millisecond is the mean of the per-track ratio Bytes/Milliseconds (computed with real division), not total Bytes divided by total Milliseconds.
Missing values are handled by the WHERE filter (NULL Bytes excluded) and by AVG skipping NULLs; Milliseconds is NOT NULL and positive so no division issues.

alternatives.interpretation: Ratio of totals: sum of Bytes divided by sum of Milliseconds across the filtered tracks, rather than the average of per-track ratios.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804;

assumptions.assumption: The average bytes per millisecond is the mean of the per-track ratio Bytes/Milliseconds, computed over tracks with Bytes > 10323804. Rows with NULL Bytes are excluded by the filter, and a cast to REAL avoids integer division.
